sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The line graph below gives information about men and women smokers in Bhutan from 1960 to 2000. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
Some people become famous at young age. Is it good thing or bad thing? You should write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
